Coram : ABHAY MANOHAR SAPRE*, S. ABDUL NAZEER
Public allotment: State largesse – Disposal of, amongst the citizens – On facts, State Housing Board, by a resolution accepted the offers of the three societies for purchase of flats of the Project, however excluded appellant No.1’s offer Held: Government, is not and should not be as free as an individual in selecting the recipients for its largesse – Government would be subject to restraints, in its position in a democratic society – In view thereof, the Board was not justified in considering only the offers made
Decision Date : 12-10-2018 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 7608/2009 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
